item_title: House GOP demands visitor logs in Biden classified docs case

item_title: Taliban start buying blue ticks on Twitter

item_title: Alabama Gov. Kay Ivey sworn in for her 2nd full term
item_description: Kim Chandler / Associated Press:  — Alabama Gov. item_title: John Kerry tells AP he backs UAE oil chief overseeing COP28

item_title: UK government to block Scottish gender bill
